notes.title: For the very first customers [Windows version download] - RESOLVED :)
notes.notes:
So! It's our first steam release... and yes we may had a very small problem with very early windows customers.

So, If you had problem downloading the game on Windows, please try again to download it.

We believe we have resolved the issue.

On the other hand if you have any problem please contact us as soon as possible to resolve your issue.

Thank you and sorry for any inconvenience.
